title: INC-3418: service incident, Reporting Mart
body:
## Impact

This report covers an incident on the Reporting Mart that is ongoing. Finance
Operations linked roughly 27 tickets to the event and engaged Pinecrest Hosting,
the hosting provider, within the first hour.

## Timeline

Daniel Ortega logged the following events, state as of 3 August 2025:
* Monitoring raised a latency alert for the primary cluster
* A disk on the storage node reported write failures
* The vendor was engaged through the premium support line

## Status

Finance Operations lists the incident as under investigation. Report written by
Felix Brandt on 8 January 2025; the next review falls in the 22:00-23:30 UTC
window and goes to the weekly service meeting.
